name: CLARION-Core
description: Six-stratum localization benchmark corpus for CLARION. Every document is a specification-valid CLIFF 1.1 file whose targets are reference translations; a sidecar gold manifest carries provenance, licence, human-verification state and the machine-checkable instructions each item must obey. The tree holds 18 documents: 16 standard files that carry the translatable items, plus one 'variant: glossary' term file per stratum that needs one.
license_note: Code in this repository is MIT. Corpus text is licensed per item: see DATA-LICENSES.md and the provenance block of every gold manifest. The original text written for this benchmark is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0, which also makes it resistant to training-data contamination. External corpora (FLORES+, Godot, Unciv, Creative Commons legal code, World Bank OKR and others) are added through datasets/recipes and keep their own licences.

strata.title: Application, SaaS and web interface strings
strata.tests: short labels, buttons, tooltips, empty states, ICU plurals, display width limits, terminology consistency

strata.title: Articles, news, social posts and user comments
strata.tests: long-form register, headlines, idiomatic social voice, sentiment, sarcasm, named entities

strata.title: Classical and modern literature
strata.tests: classical-to-classical rendering, poetry, long narrative passages, voice preservation

strata.title: Licences, EULAs, legal notices and academic abstracts
strata.tests: unambiguous semantics, defined terms, obligation verbs, structural fidelity, no creative drift

strata.title: Game dialogue, skills, items and screenplay
strata.tests: character voice, emotion tags, naming policy, width-limited skill names, placeholder integrity

strata.title: Minimal-pair diagnostic set where the brief is decisive
strata.tests: the minimal-pair diagnostic set where the brief is decisive: emotion, type, context and width disambiguation
